test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter cluster in the same way as the second letter cluster is related to the first letter cluster and the fourth letter cluster is related to the third letter cluster.

AREA : BRFA : : BABY : CACY : : GOLD : ?
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af7f5248a0c6050307cf17b8c83db8e491536f519fe8ba8a2eb262575c9e9f06.png] 

1) AREA : BRFA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dadac175f04bb3b8f0634f844de164d73c14961db47c62df2c6361103be72934.png] 

And,

2) BABY : CACY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b2676aadcd6b93abefbb314ce4142d938301580c58bfc06c767b5248d615c0a.png] 

Similarly,

3) GOLD : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f27bc955bd6bf281c22a5c4571cb7f2553cf1a39b12cd8e5b6a232d9793ed7f8.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HOMD".**
